result.summary: The page is largely functional, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has clear alignment/consistency defects and content is clipped at the right and bottom edges. Found 6 issues (1 major layout, several minor).

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not vertically aligned: the Green Bowl Poké image starts higher and is shorter than the Smash Bros Burgers card, so the time badges, restaurant names and delivery prices sit on different baselines across the row.
issues.suggestion: Use a fixed image aspect ratio and a consistent card container height with aligned top edges so badges and text baselines match across all carousel items.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light/grey background while the other two thumbnails use dark food photography, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Standardize thumbnail treatment (same background/overlay/gradient) or apply a consistent scrim to all card images.

issues.description: 'Trattoria Piccol...' name and its card are cut off at the right screen edge with no ellipsis or peek indicator, so users may not realize the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Truncate long titles with an ellipsis and add a partial card peek/edge gradient plus horizontal padding to signal scrollability.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar; its name, rating and metadata are not visible and there is no bottom padding for the fixed nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) icons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card has a plain white outline heart while the pizza card's heart sits inside a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Use one favorite-button style (preferably a contrast-backed circular button) on all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' twice — once as an overlay badge on the image and again in the metadata line.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery promotion in only one place, or make the badge convey something distinct (e.g. 'Free delivery').

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off at the right edge and the notification bell's red dot has no visible label/count, so its meaning relies on color alone.
issues.suggestion: Indicate horizontal scroll for chips and pair the notification dot with an accessible label or count for screen readers.
